scripts.check: npm run types && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply ithaca-journal-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply ithaca-journal-production --remote --env production
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run validate:access:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run validate:access:production && wrangler deploy --env production
